spans.s:
m. (-फः)
1 Phlegm, one of the three humours of the body.
2 Watery froth or foam in general.
E.
क water, and फल to bud or flower, ड aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
Producing phlegm.
E.
कफ, and कर what makes.

f. (-का)
Saliva, spittle.
E.
कफ, and कूर्च्चिका cream.

mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं)
Removing phlegm, antiphlegmatic, (an epithet of many plants, &c.)
E.
कफ, and घ्न what destroys.

mf. (-णिः-णी)
The elbow.
E.
क pleasure, फण to go, इन् and ङीष् affixes; also कफोणि.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Antiphlegmatic.
E.
कफ, and नाशन destroying.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Exciting phlegm.
E.
कफ, and वर्द्धक what increases.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
Exciting phlegm.
m. (-नः)
The name of a plant; also पिण्डीतगर.
E.
कफ phlegm, वृध to augment, and ल्युट् aff.

m. (-रिः)
Ginger.
E.
कफ, and अरि foe.

mfn. (-फी-फिनी-फी)
Phlegmatic.
m. (-फी)
An elephant.
E.
कफ and इनि aff.

mfn. (-लूः-लूः-लु)
Phlegmatic, causing or exciting phlegm.
E.
कफ, लू from ला to take or give, and कू Uṇādi affix; the deriv. is irr.

mf. (-णिः-णी)
The elbow.
E.
क pleasure, स्फुर् to go, &c. इन् and ङीष् affixes; the form is irregular: see कफणि.

m. (-लः)
A bitter seed: see कट्फल.
E.
का bad, and फल fruit.
